definitions.explanation: A venue that displays and often sells works of art, particularly paintings. Refers to both commercial galleries and exhibition spaces.

examples.japanese: {銀座|ぎんざ}の{画廊|がろう}を{巡|めぐ}った。
{友人|ゆうじん}が{画廊|がろう}で{個展|こてん}を{開|ひら}いている。
examples.english: A friend of mine is holding a solo exhibition at a gallery.

examples.japanese: この{画廊|がろう}は{若手|わかて}アーティストの{作品|さくひん}を{中心|ちゅうしん}に{扱|あつか}っている。
examples.english: This gallery mainly handles works by young artists.

notes:
USAGE:
{画廊|がろう} has a more traditional, refined nuance compared to the loanword ギャラリー. It is often used for smaller, established galleries that deal in fine art, especially paintings. ギャラリー is broader and more casual, also used for photography exhibitions and modern art spaces.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {画廊|がろう}を{巡|めぐ}る (to visit galleries)
- {画廊|がろう}で{個展|こてん}を{開|ひら}く (to hold a solo exhibition at a gallery)
- {画廊|がろう}に{飾|かざ}る (to display at a gallery)
- {貸|かし}{画廊|がろう} (rental gallery)

WORD FORMATION:
{画|が} (painting, picture) + {廊|ろう} (corridor, gallery).
